correctness.rationale: Complete proof: all orientation signings map to segment endpoint sums with exponent equal to the sum of squared signed degrees. Walsh expansion selects only even-degree edge subsets; in a connected unicyclic graph those are the empty set and the unique cycle. Their coefficients are F and signed B products, and subtraction of both directed-cycle assignments yields the exact formula. All graph sizes and normalizations are explicit. An independent enumeration of 1,168,282 vertices across 2,500 configurations corroborates it.
